news.body:
## Tomorrow is the last day anything is open
- Three dates land on or straight after the weekend.
The KITAS closure is Sunday, the Career Anchor scores Monday, the instalment Tuesday. Class runs to seven tonight and again tomorrow, and after that nothing of yours is open until Monday morning.
- The Locus letter is the one that cannot wait.
Of the three documents Ascentium asked for it is the only one you cannot write yourself, and it has to come from Jishnu. Asking him on Monday leaves him no time at all.
- Missing Monday on the Career Anchors costs the session, not just the task.
Liesbeth wants them 48 hours before she sees you on the 25th, which is where the 23rd comes from. It is marked quick and you have not opened it once.
